title: Family Experience Days & Gift Experiences: How to Choose
description: Family experience days and gift experiences: balloon flights, animal encounters, junior driving and treetop adventures, and how vouchers work.
h1: Family experience days and gift experiences
intro: Memories over things. Experience days make brilliant gifts for kids, grandparents and whole families. Here’s what’s out there, who it suits and how to avoid voucher headaches.

image.alt: Colourful hot air balloons floating in a blue sky

blocks.title: Scout’s verdict on experience days
blocks.text: Experience vouchers make lovely gifts, but read the small print first: age and height limits, weather cancellations, expiry dates and whether you book with the voucher company or the venue.

items.title: Hot air balloon flights
items.text: Unforgettable, but weather-dependent and with minimum age and height limits. Best for older kids and teens.

items.title: Animal encounters
items.text: Meet penguins, lemurs or giraffes at zoos and farm parks. Many have minimum ages, so check before you buy.

items.title: Junior driving experiences
items.text: Under-17s can drive real cars on private tracks at some UK venues. A dream gift for car-mad teens.

items.title: Treetop & adventure parks
items.text: Zip lines, rope courses and climbing for active families. Height and age rules apply.

items.title: Theatre & shows
items.text: West End and Broadway family shows, pantomimes at Christmas and touring children’s shows.

items.title: Behind-the-scenes tours
items.text: Studio tours, sports stadium tours and chocolate factory visits make great rainy-day gifts.

sections.html:
1. You buy a voucher for a specific experience, or a “choice” voucher with several options.
  2. The recipient books a date, either with the voucher company or directly with the venue.
  3. Vouchers have an expiry date. Some can be extended or exchanged for a fee, so check the terms.

Read Scout’s full guide to experience day gifts for families.

faqs.q: What is a good experience day for a family?
faqs.a: Animal encounters, treetop adventures, behind-the-scenes tours and theatre trips work for most ages. Balloon flights and driving experiences suit older children and teens.
Most do. Check the validity period before buying, and whether you can extend or exchange the voucher if plans change.
